header: Features by engine version in Amazon OpenSearch Service
content:
Many OpenSearch Service features have a minimum OpenSearch version requirement or legacy
Elasticsearch OSS version requirement. If you meet the minimum version for a feature, but the
feature isn't available on your domain, update your domain's service software.
